description: Contract verification and ABI. Whether a contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism is source-verified (Sourcify), its name, compiler, full ABI, function and event signatures, and its EIP-1967 proxy implementation (also looked up). Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","address":"0x…","isContract":true,"verified":true,"match":"exact_match","name":"FiatTokenProxy","compiler":"0.6.12","proxyImplementation":"0x…","functions":["admin()"],"events":["Upgraded(address)"],"abi":[]}. Price: $0.0032 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: contract_abi
